Remark
[the two-dimensional case]

Source: petersen:page-0139 ↗ prop:pet-ch4-rotsym-ricci-scalar When $n=2$ there are no tangential curvatures, so $\mathrm{sec}=-\ddot\rho /\rho $; this is a genuine difference between $2$-dimensional and higher-dimensional rotationally symmetric metrics.
